text:
adrian.sales: Quick sync — MedTech customer wants a 2-week POC using our Hosted API but needs a Private/VPC fallback for high-sensitivity flows. Asks: scoped/ephemeral API keys, SAML SSO for console access, sample audit logs (schema + retention), ability to stream logs to Splunk HEC or S3 with role, proof of KMS integration, and an estimate for Dedicated trial pricing. Can we stand this up next week?

maria.se: Yes. Typical POC pattern: start hosted (scoped key + IP allowlist) then optional Private (VPC peering). Logs: HEC or S3 export supported. For short POCs we issue ephemeral keys with TTL.

ben.sre: Audit log format: one NDJSON line per request with fields: request_id, timestamp, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, route, status, error_code (if any), tenant_id (if provided), region, host_id, latency_ms, kv_cache_hit. Default hosted retention: 30 days; exports to S3 can be kept longer via lifecycle rules.

priya.security: KMS notes: Hosted uses our managed KMS by default. Private/VPC supports customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS or external HSM) but onboarding CMK and key policy adjustments take ~2-3 business days plus security review. If they require PHI handling, confirm redaction/encryption requirements.

sam.platform: Dedicated pricing: we can offer a short Dedicated pool trial but it requires a temporary reserved commit; we usually do a one-week minimum for evaluation. Need ARR estimate to price appropriately. @adrian.sales please collect numbers.

maria.se: For logs we'll need either:
1) Splunk HEC endpoint + HEC token + allowed IP ranges OR
2) S3 bucket name + write IAM role ARN + preferred prefix + retention policy.
For SAML SSO: provide IdP metadata XML or URL; we provide SP ACS. SCIM not available for POC — manual provisioning only.

adrian.sales: They also want sample audit artifacts for their SOC2 reviewers pre-kickoff. We can provide a redacted sample export and our SOC2 cert after NDA.

priya.security: Get the NDA signed first. Once done I will provide redacted logs and a controls mapping. Also send their security questionnaire now — I'll triage high-risk items. :eyes:

ops-bot: Audit export job created for thread 1912468000 — temporary bucket path s3://redwood-poc-exports/medtech/1912468000/ (auto-delete after 14 days).

ben.sre: Example NDJSON line (redacted):
```
{"request_id":"req_01GZxP","timestamp":"2026-03-18T15:02:11Z","tenant_id":"redacted","model":"gptx-3.8","prompt_tokens":54,"completion_tokens":128,"total_tokens":182,"route":"hosted-us-west-2","status":"ok","latency_ms":132} 
```

maria.se: Ephemeral key flow for POC: create scoped key with TTL 24h, scope=generate, routes=[hosted-us-west-2], allowed_ips=[customer egress]. Example API: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin_token>" \\
  -d '{"name":"medtech-poc-ephemeral","ttl_seconds":86400,"scopes":["generate"],"allowed_ips":["198.51.100.0/24"]}'
```
Response includes ephemeral_key and expires_at.

adrian.sales: Can we forward logs to their Splunk over TLS? Also they want console SSO for 4 users during the POC.

priya.security: Splunk HEC over TLS is supported; we'll validate the cert chain for custom endpoints. SAML console access for 4 users is fine once we get IdP metadata. SCIM provisioning is manual for POC.

devex: I'll assemble a short runbook with commands, sample dashboards, and Splunk searches for token counts and errors. Will post runbook link: https://internal.redwood.runbooks/medtech-poc (team-only).

sam.platform: Blockers list to call out: 1) NDA signed for SOC2 artifacts 2) Customer IdP metadata for SAML 3) If CMK required, security onboarding ~3 business days 4) Dedicated pool temporary commit approval if they opt-in.

adrian.sales: Timeline: customer hopes to start next Tue. I'll escalate NDA and IdP today. If we can get log hookup and ephemeral keys before then, great.

maria.se: I'll open an infra ticket to provision ephemeral key + IP allowlist + S3 export path. Assigning to @ben.sre for S3/HEC hookup and @devex for the runbook.

ben.sre: Taking S3/HEC hookup. I'll need their HEC token or bucket role. First export stream can be running ~6-8 hours after creds received.

priya.security: Please upload the customer's security questionnaire now — I'll mark any high-risk responses and propose mitigations. For blocking items we will escalate to Legal. :white_check_mark:

adrian.sales: Uploaded questionnaire: https://files.redwood/medtech/sq-1912468000.pdf — please review.

maria.se: I'll follow up with a checklist summary in this thread after SFQ validation. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
